info.name: Student Accommodation API
info.description: API tests for the COMP 3613 Student Accommodation app. Run the folders in order (Collection Runner): later requests reuse the listing, application and booking created earlier. Start the app first: python manage.py init && python manage.py run.

item.name: 0. Authentication and accounts
Register a new student

exec: pm.test("Account is a student and the password is not echoed", function () { pm.expect(body.role).to.eql("regular_user"); pm.expect(body).to.not.have.property("password"); });

item.name: Register with a taken username is rejected
Register with an invalid email is rejected
Login with a wrong password is rejected
Login as landlord
Login as admin
Login as bob
Login as fred
Current user (Bob)

exec: pm.test("Is Bob, a student", function () { pm.expect(body.username).to.eql("bob"); pm.expect(body.role).to.eql("regular_user"); });

item.name: Current user without a token is rejected
User list as admin

exec: pm.test("Lists users without passwords", function () { pm.expect(body).to.be.an("array").that.is.not.empty; body.forEach(function (u) { pm.expect(u).to.not.have.property("password"); }); });

item.name: User list as a student is forbidden
User list without a token is rejected
1. Workflow: Post listing detail for verification (Landlord, Admin)
Landlord posts a listing for verification

exec: pm.test("Listing starts Pending and available", function () { pm.expect(body.verification_status).to.eql("Pending"); pm.expect(body.availability).to.eql(true); pm.expect(body.price).to.eql(2500); });

item.name: A Pending listing is not public
Landlord sees the new listing as Pending

exec: pm.test("Newest listing is first and Pending", function () { pm.expect(body.items[0].id).to.eql(parseInt(pm.collectionVariables.get("listingId"))); pm.expect(body.items[0].verification_status).to.eql("Pending"); });

item.name: A student cannot open the admin queue
Admin sees the listing in the pending queue

exec: pm.test("Queue contains the new listing", function () { const ids = body.items.map(function (i) { return i.id; }); pm.expect(ids).to.include(parseInt(pm.collectionVariables.get("listingId"))); pm.expect(body.limit).to.eql(5); });

item.name: A landlord cannot verify listings
Rejecting without a reason is refused
Admin approves the listing
The Verified listing is now public
Search finds the listing by address
A decided listing cannot be decided again
2. Workflow: Apply to listed accommodation (Student)
A landlord cannot apply
Student applies to the listing
A duplicate active application is refused
Student lists their own applications

exec: pm.test("Newest application is the new one", function () { pm.expect(body.items[0].id).to.eql(parseInt(pm.collectionVariables.get("applicationId"))); });

item.name: Landlord sees the application in their inbox

exec: pm.test("Inbox has the application", function () { const ids = body.items.map(function (a) { return a.id; }); pm.expect(ids).to.include(parseInt(pm.collectionVariables.get("applicationId"))); });

item.name: Cannot accept before details are submitted
Student cannot submit details before they are requested
A student cannot request details
Landlord requests the student's details

exec: pm.test("Status is Info Requested", function () { pm.expect(body.status).to.eql("Info Requested"); });

item.name: Another student cannot submit the details
An age of zero is rejected
Student submits the requested details

exec: pm.test("Details saved and status is Info Submitted", function () { pm.expect(body.status).to.eql("Info Submitted"); pm.expect(body.student_name).to.eql("Bob Smith"); pm.expect(body.student_age).to.eql(21); });

item.name: Declining without a reason is refused
Landlord accepts the application
The accepted application has a booking awaiting payment

exec: pm.test("Booking awaits payment", function () { pm.expect(body.status).to.eql("Awaiting Payment"); pm.expect(body.start_date).to.eql("2027-01-10"); });

item.name: Another student cannot pay for the booking
A blank payment method is refused
Student pays the security fee and first month

exec: pm.test("Amount is rent plus security fee and marked paid", function () { pm.expect(body.amount).to.eql(3000); pm.expect(body.paid).to.eql(true); pm.expect(body.type).to.eql("card"); });

item.name: Paying twice is refused
The booking is now Confirmed
The listing is now unavailable
Applying to an unavailable listing is refused
3. Workflow: Submit review of completed stay (Student)
Cannot review before the stay is completed
Move-out date must be after the start date
Another student cannot give notice
Student gives move-out notice

exec: pm.test("Status is Notice Given with the move-out date", function () { pm.expect(body.status).to.eql("Notice Given"); pm.expect(body.move_out_date).to.eql("2027-06-30"); });

item.name: A student cannot complete the booking
Landlord marks the stay completed
The listing is available again
A rating of 6 is rejected
Another student cannot review the stay
Student submits a review of the completed stay

exec: pm.test("Review is saved against the listing", function () { pm.expect(body.rating).to.eql(5); pm.expect(body.reviewer).to.eql("bob"); pm.expect(body.listing_id).to.eql(parseInt(pm.collectionVariables.get("listingId"))); });

item.name: A second review for the same booking is refused
The listing shows the review and its average rating

exec: pm.test("One review by bob and an average of 5", function () { pm.expect(body.total_count).to.eql(1); pm.expect(body.items[0].reviewer).to.eql("bob"); pm.expect(body.items[0].comment).to.include("Quiet"); pm.expect(body.average_rating).to.eql(5); });
